model.enterprise_ai_analytics_platform.s.name: stg_transactions
model.enterprise_ai_analytics_platform.s.description: Staging view of commercial banking transactions. Grain: one row per transaction_id.
model.enterprise_ai_analytics_platform.s.raw_code:
-- =============================================================================
-- Model: stg_transactions
-- Grain: One row per commercial transaction (transaction_id)
-- Source: raw.transactions
-- =============================================================================

with source as (
    select
        transaction_id,
        account_id,
        counterparty_account_id,
        transaction_type,
        channel,
        direction,
        transaction_amount,
        transaction_currency,
        settlement_currency,
        customer_fx_rate,
        base_currency_amount,
        status,
        original_transaction_id,
        journal_id,
        initiated_at,
        settled_at,
        created_at
    from {{ source('raw', 'transactions') }}
)

select
    cast(transaction_id as varchar(64)) as transaction_id,
    cast(account_id as varchar(64)) as account_id,
    cast(counterparty_account_id as varchar(64)) as counterparty_account_id,
    upper(trim(cast(transaction_type as varchar(32)))) as transaction_type,
    upper(trim(cast(channel as varchar(32)))) as channel,
    upper(trim(cast(direction as varchar(16)))) as direction,
    cast(transaction_amount as numeric(18, 4)) as transaction_amount,
    upper(trim(cast(transaction_currency as varchar(3)))) as transaction_currency,
    upper(trim(cast(settlement_currency as varchar(3)))) as settlement_currency,
    cast(customer_fx_rate as numeric(18, 6)) as customer_fx_rate,
    cast(base_currency_amount as numeric(18, 4)) as base_currency_amount,
    upper(trim(cast(status as varchar(32)))) as transaction_status,
    cast(original_transaction_id as varchar(64)) as original_transaction_id,
    cast(journal_id as varchar(64)) as journal_id,
    cast(initiated_at as timestamptz) as initiated_at,
    cast(initiated_at as date) as transaction_date,
    cast(settled_at as timestamptz) as settled_at,
    cast(settled_at as date) as settlement_date,
    case
        when upper(trim(status)) in ('SETTLED', 'REVERSED') then true
        else false
    end as is_settled_or_reversed,
    case
        when original_transaction_id is not null or upper(trim(status)) = 'REVERSED' then true
        else false
    end as is_reversal_related,
    cast(created_at as timestamptz) as created_at
from source

-- =============================================================================
-- Model: dim_accounts
-- Layer: Marts (Core Dimension)
-- Grain: One row per customer bank account (account_id)
-- =============================================================================

with customer_accounts as (
    select
        account_id,
        account_number,
        account_type,
        account_currency,
        opening_balance,
        reserved_funds,
        initial_available_balance,
        account_status,
        opened_at,
        opened_date,
        customer_id,
        legal_entity_id,
        customer_name,
        customer_segment,
        customer_status,
        has_overdraft_facility,
        overdraft_facility_count,
        primary_facility_id,
        authorized_overdraft_limit,
        initial_total_liquidity,
        standard_interest_rate,
        unauthorized_penalty_rate,
        earliest_facility_start_date,
        latest_facility_end_date
    from {{ ref('int_customer_accounts') }}
),

subledger_movements as (
    -- Subledger customer deposit movements in native account currency
    -- For GL_LIAB_CUSTOMER_DEPOSITS (normal_balance = CREDIT):
    -- CREDIT increases customer balance, DEBIT decreases customer balance.
    select
        account_id,
        currency,
        count(entry_id) as subledger_posting_count,
        sum(credit_amount) as total_credits_posted,
        sum(debit_amount) as total_debits_posted,
        sum(credit_amount - debit_amount) as net_subledger_movement
    from {{ ref('stg_ledger_entries') }}
    where account_type_marker = 'CUSTOMER'
    group by
        account_id,
        currency
)

select
    ca.account_id,
    ca.account_number,
    ca.customer_id,
    ca.legal_entity_id,
    ca.customer_name,
    ca.customer_segment,
    ca.customer_status,
    ca.account_type,
    ca.account_currency,
    ca.account_status,
    ca.opening_balance,
    ca.reserved_funds,
    ca.initial_available_balance,
    ca.has_overdraft_facility,
    ca.overdraft_facility_count,
    ca.primary_facility_id,
    ca.authorized_overdraft_limit,
    ca.initial_total_liquidity,
    ca.standard_interest_rate,
    ca.unauthorized_penalty_rate,
    ca.earliest_facility_start_date,
    ca.latest_facility_end_date,
    coalesce(sm.subledger_posting_count, 0) as subledger_posting_count,
    cast(coalesce(sm.total_credits_posted, 0.0000) as numeric(18, 4)) as total_credits_posted,
    cast(coalesce(sm.total_debits_posted, 0.0000) as numeric(18, 4)) as total_debits_posted,
    cast(coalesce(sm.net_subledger_movement, 0.0000) as numeric(18, 4)) as net_subledger_movement,
    cast(
        ca.opening_balance + coalesce(sm.net_subledger_movement, 0.0000)
        as numeric(18, 4)
    ) as closing_ledger_balance,
    ca.opened_at,
    ca.opened_date
from customer_accounts ca
left join subledger_movements sm
    on ca.account_id = sm.account_id
    and ca.account_currency = sm.currency

    c.created_at

-- =============================================================================
-- Model: dim_date
-- Layer: Marts (Core Dimension)
-- Grain: One row per calendar date (date_day)
-- =============================================================================

with calendar_dates as (
    select distinct
        rate_date as date_day
    from {{ ref('stg_fx_rates') }}
)

select
    date_day,
    cast(extract(year from date_day) as integer) as calendar_year,
    cast(extract(quarter from date_day) as integer) as calendar_quarter,
    cast(extract(month from date_day) as integer) as calendar_month,
    to_char(date_day, 'YYYY-MM') as year_month,
    cast(date_trunc('month', date_day) as date) as first_day_of_month,
    cast(extract(day from date_day) as integer) as day_of_month,
    cast(extract(isodow from date_day) as integer) as iso_day_of_week,
    trim(to_char(date_day, 'Day')) as day_name,
    case
        when extract(isodow from date_day) in (6, 7) then true
        else false
    end as is_weekend
from calendar_dates

    -- Separate debit and credit amounts in native posting currency
    le.currency,
    le.amount,
    le.debit_amount,
    le.credit_amount,
    le.signed_debit_minus_credit,
    -- Explicit EUR reporting conversion via daily ECB mid-rate on posting_date

-- =============================================================================
-- Model: fct_customer_revenue
-- Layer: Marts (Finance Fact)
-- Grain: One row per customer_id, reporting_month, currency, and revenue_category
-- Purpose: Governed customer profitability and fee revenue mart preserving
--          native currencies alongside explicit EUR reporting values.
-- =============================================================================

with customer_revenue as (
    select
        customer_id,
        customer_name,
        customer_segment,
        reporting_month,
        currency,
        revenue_category,
        assessment_count,
        active_fee_account_count,
        collection_attempt_count,
        successful_collection_count,
        failed_collection_count,
        gross_assessed_fee_amount,
        waived_fee_amount,
        net_collectible_fee_amount,
        collected_fee_amount,
        outstanding_fee_amount,
        gross_collected_revenue,
        reversed_revenue_amount,
        pass_through_cost_amount,
        net_recognized_revenue,
        gross_assessed_fee_amount_eur,
        waived_fee_amount_eur,
        net_collectible_fee_amount_eur,
        collected_fee_amount_eur,
        outstanding_fee_amount_eur,
        gross_collected_revenue_eur,
        reversed_revenue_amount_eur,
        pass_through_cost_amount_eur,
        net_recognized_revenue_eur
    from {{ ref('int_customer_revenue') }}
)

select
    -- Deterministic composite grain identifier
    concat(
        customer_id,
        '|',
        to_char(reporting_month, 'YYYY-MM'),
        '|',
        currency,
        '|',
        revenue_category
    ) as customer_revenue_id,
    customer_id,
    customer_name,
    customer_segment,
    reporting_month,
    to_char(reporting_month, 'YYYY-MM') as year_month,
    currency,
    revenue_category,
    assessment_count,
    active_fee_account_count,
    collection_attempt_count,
    successful_collection_count,
    failed_collection_count,
    -- Native currency metrics (NUMERIC(18,4))
    gross_assessed_fee_amount,
    waived_fee_amount,
    net_collectible_fee_amount,
    collected_fee_amount,
    outstanding_fee_amount,
    gross_collected_revenue,
    reversed_revenue_amount,
    pass_through_cost_amount,
    net_recognized_revenue,
    -- Explicit EUR reporting metrics (NUMERIC(18,4))
    'EUR' as reporting_currency,
    gross_assessed_fee_amount_eur,
    waived_fee_amount_eur,
    net_collectible_fee_amount_eur,
    collected_fee_amount_eur,
    outstanding_fee_amount_eur,
    gross_collected_revenue_eur,
    reversed_revenue_amount_eur,
    pass_through_cost_amount_eur,
    net_recognized_revenue_eur,
    -- Governed ratios
    cast(
        case
            when net_collectible_fee_amount > 0.0000
                then round(collected_fee_amount / net_collectible_fee_amount, 4)
            else 0.0000
        end
        as numeric(7, 4)
    ) as fee_collection_rate,
    cast(
        case
            when gross_assessed_fee_amount > 0.0000
                then round(waived_fee_amount / gross_assessed_fee_amount, 4)
            else 0.0000
        end
        as numeric(7, 4)
    ) as fee_waiver_rate,
    cast(
        case
            when gross_assessed_fee_amount > 0.0000
                then round((waived_fee_amount + outstanding_fee_amount) / gross_assessed_fee_amount, 4)
            else 0.0000
        end
        as numeric(7, 4)
    ) as total_fee_leakage_rate
from customer_revenue

-- =============================================================================
-- Model: fct_fee_collections
-- Layer: Marts (Finance Fact)
-- Grain: One row per fee collection attempt (collection_id)
-- =============================================================================

with collections as (
    select
        collection_id,
        assessment_id,
        account_id,
        collection_attempt_number,
        target_amount,
        collected_amount,
        outstanding_amount,
        collection_status,
        failure_reason,
        attempted_at,
        attempted_date,
        settled_at,
        settled_date,
        linked_ledger_entry_id
    from {{ ref('stg_fee_collections') }}
),

assessments as (
    select
        assessment_id,
        transaction_id,
        gross_assessed_amount,
        waived_amount,
        net_collectible_amount,
        assessment_status
    from {{ ref('stg_fee_assessments') }}
),

transactions_context as (
    select
        transaction_id,
        customer_id,
        customer_name,
        customer_segment,
        account_number,
        account_type,
        account_currency,
        transaction_type as fee_type,
        channel
    from {{ ref('int_transactions_enriched') }}
),

recognitions_agg as (
    -- Pure financial aggregation by collection_id (1:0..1 enforced by unique_stg_revenue_recognitions_collection_id)
    select
        collection_id,
        sum(gross_collected_revenue) as gross_collected_revenue,
        sum(reversed_revenue_amount) as reversed_revenue_amount,
        sum(pass_through_cost) as pass_through_cost,
        sum(net_recognized_revenue) as net_recognized_revenue,
        max(recognized_at) as recognized_at,
        max(recognized_date) as recognized_date
    from {{ ref('stg_revenue_recognitions') }}
    group by collection_id
),

ranked_recognitions as (
    select
        collection_id,
        recognition_id,
        row_number() over (
            partition by collection_id
            order by
                recognized_at desc,
                recognition_id desc
        ) as recognition_rank_desc
    from {{ ref('stg_revenue_recognitions') }}
),

recognitions as (
    select
        ra.collection_id,
        rr.recognition_id,
        ra.gross_collected_revenue,
        ra.reversed_revenue_amount,
        ra.pass_through_cost,
        ra.net_recognized_revenue,
        ra.recognized_at,
        ra.recognized_date
    from recognitions_agg ra
    left join ranked_recognitions rr
        on ra.collection_id = rr.collection_id
        and rr.recognition_rank_desc = 1
),

fx_to_eur as (
    select
        rate_date,
        from_currency,
        mid_rate as eur_fx_rate,
        rate_source as eur_fx_rate_source
    from {{ ref('stg_fx_rates') }}
    where to_currency = 'EUR'
)

select
    c.collection_id,
    c.assessment_id,
    a.transaction_id,
    tc.customer_id,
    tc.customer_name,
    tc.customer_segment,
    c.account_id,
    tc.account_number,
    tc.account_type,
    tc.fee_type,
    tc.channel,
    c.collection_attempt_number,
    -- Native currency collection attempt and revenue recognition amounts
    tc.account_currency as currency,
    c.target_amount,
    c.collected_amount,
    c.outstanding_amount,
    r.recognition_id,
    cast(coalesce(r.gross_collected_revenue, 0.0000) as numeric(18, 4)) as gross_collected_revenue,
    cast(coalesce(r.reversed_revenue_amount, 0.0000) as numeric(18, 4)) as reversed_revenue_amount,
    cast(coalesce(r.pass_through_cost, 0.0000) as numeric(18, 4)) as pass_through_cost,
    cast(coalesce(r.net_recognized_revenue, 0.0000) as numeric(18, 4)) as net_recognized_revenue,
    -- Explicit EUR reporting conversion on attempted_date
    'EUR' as reporting_currency,
    fx.eur_fx_rate,
    fx.eur_fx_rate_source,
    cast(round(c.target_amount * fx.eur_fx_rate, 4) as numeric(18, 4)) as target_amount_eur,
    cast(round(c.collected_amount * fx.eur_fx_rate, 4) as numeric(18, 4)) as collected_amount_eur,
    cast(round(c.outstanding_amount * fx.eur_fx_rate, 4) as numeric(18, 4)) as outstanding_amount_eur,

-- =============================================================================
-- Model: int_journal_balances
-- Grain: One row per accounting journal and currency leg (journal_id + currency)
-- Purpose: Verify double-entry accounting balance per journal and currency leg,
--          tracking total debits, total credits, net imbalance, and entry counts.
-- =============================================================================

with journals as (
    select
        journal_id,
        transaction_id,
        journal_type,
        description,
        journal_created_at,
        journal_date
    from {{ ref('stg_journals') }}
),

ledger_legs as (
    select
        journal_id,
        currency,
        count(entry_id) as entry_count,
        sum(debit_amount) as total_debit_amount,
        sum(credit_amount) as total_credit_amount,
        sum(signed_debit_minus_credit) as net_imbalance_amount,
        min(posted_at) as first_posted_at,
        max(posted_at) as last_posted_at
    from {{ ref('stg_ledger_entries') }}
    group by
        journal_id,
        currency
)

select
    j.journal_id,
    l.currency,
    j.transaction_id,
    j.journal_type,
    j.description,
    j.journal_created_at,
    j.journal_date,
    l.entry_count,
    cast(l.total_debit_amount as numeric(18, 4)) as total_debit_amount,
    cast(l.total_credit_amount as numeric(18, 4)) as total_credit_amount,
    cast(l.net_imbalance_amount as numeric(18, 4)) as net_imbalance_amount,
    abs(l.net_imbalance_amount) = 0.0000 as is_balanced,
    l.first_posted_at,
    l.last_posted_at
from journals j
inner join ledger_legs l
    on j.journal_id = l.journal_id

-- =============================================================================
-- Model: int_fee_lifecycle
-- Grain: One row per fee assessment (assessment_id)
-- Purpose: Reconcile the end-to-end fee lifecycle from assessment through
--          collection attempts and revenue recognition without join fan-out.
--          Separates assessment-level numeric aggregation from deterministic
--          chronological latest-attempt selection (ROW_NUMBER()).
-- =============================================================================

with assessments as (
    select
        assessment_id,
        transaction_id,
        account_id,
        gross_assessed_amount,
        waived_amount,
        waiver_reason,
        net_collectible_amount,
        assessment_status,
        assessed_at,
        assessed_date
    from {{ ref('stg_fee_assessments') }}
),

-- Step 1a: Pure numeric and timestamp aggregation of revenue recognitions by collection_id.
-- Note: 1:0..1 cardinality per collection_id is enforced by dbt generic tests
-- `source_unique_raw_revenue_recognitions_collection_id` (raw_sources.yml) and
-- `unique_stg_revenue_recognitions_collection_id` (_staging__models.yml), while
-- raw.revenue_recognitions DDL permits multi-row adjustments. Numeric aggregation
-- is kept strictly separate from deterministic latest-recognition selection below.
recognitions_agg_by_collection as (
    select
        collection_id,
        count(recognition_id) as recognition_count,
        sum(gross_collected_revenue) as gross_collected_revenue,
        sum(reversed_revenue_amount) as reversed_revenue_amount,
        sum(pass_through_cost) as pass_through_cost,
        sum(net_recognized_revenue) as net_recognized_revenue,
        max(recognized_at) as recognized_at
    from {{ ref('stg_revenue_recognitions') }}
    group by collection_id
),

-- Step 1b: Deterministic chronological latest-recognition selection per collection_id
ranked_recognitions_by_collection as (
    select
        collection_id,
        recognition_id as latest_recognition_id_for_collection,
        row_number() over (
            partition by collection_id
            order by
                recognized_at desc,
                recognition_id desc
        ) as recognition_rank_desc
    from {{ ref('stg_revenue_recognitions') }}
),

latest_recognition_by_collection as (
    select
        collection_id,
        latest_recognition_id_for_collection
    from ranked_recognitions_by_collection
    where recognition_rank_desc = 1
),

-- Step 2: Join collection attempts (1:0..1) with pre-aggregated recognitions
collections_with_rev as (
    select
        fc.collection_id,
        fc.assessment_id,
        fc.account_id,
        fc.collection_attempt_number,
        fc.target_amount,
        fc.collected_amount,
        fc.outstanding_amount,
        fc.collection_status,
        fc.failure_reason,
        fc.attempted_at,
        fc.settled_at,
        fc.linked_ledger_entry_id,
        lrc.latest_recognition_id_for_collection as recognition_id,
        coalesce(rr.gross_collected_revenue, 0.0000) as gross_collected_revenue,
        coalesce(rr.reversed_revenue_amount, 0.0000) as reversed_revenue_amount,
        coalesce(rr.pass_through_cost, 0.0000) as pass_through_cost,
        coalesce(rr.net_recognized_revenue, 0.0000) as net_recognized_revenue,
        rr.recognized_at
    from {{ ref('stg_fee_collections') }} fc
    left join recognitions_agg_by_collection rr
        on fc.collection_id = rr.collection_id
    left join latest_recognition_by_collection lrc
        on fc.collection_id = lrc.collection_id
),

-- Step 3: Deterministic chronological latest-record selection per assessment_id
ranked_collection_attempts as (
    select
        assessment_id,
        collection_id as latest_collection_id,
        recognition_id as latest_recognition_id,
        linked_ledger_entry_id,
        collection_status as latest_collection_status,
        failure_reason as latest_failure_reason,
        row_number() over (
            partition by assessment_id
            order by
                attempted_at desc,
                collection_attempt_number desc,
                collection_id desc
        ) as attempt_rank_desc
    from collections_with_rev
),

latest_collection_per_assessment as (
    select
        assessment_id,
        latest_collection_id,
        latest_recognition_id,
        linked_ledger_entry_id,
        latest_collection_status,
        latest_failure_reason
    from ranked_collection_attempts
    where attempt_rank_desc = 1
),

-- Step 4: Pure assessment-level numeric and timestamp roll-up
assessment_collections_agg as (
    select
        assessment_id,
        count(collection_id) as total_collection_attempts,
        count(case when collection_status in ('SETTLED', 'PARTIAL') then 1 end) as successful_collection_attempts,
        count(case when collection_status = 'FAILED' then 1 end) as failed_collection_attempts,
        sum(
            case

--          Separates assessment-level numeric aggregation from deterministic
--          chronological latest-attempt selection (ROW_NUMBER()).

with assessments as (
    select
        assessment_id,
        transaction_id,
        account_id,
        gross_assessed_amount,
        waived_amount,
        waiver_reason,
        net_collectible_amount,
        assessment_status,
        assessed_at,
        assessed_date
    from "analytics_platform"."analytics"."stg_fee_assessments"
),

-- Step 1a: Pure numeric and timestamp aggregation of revenue recognitions by collection_id.
-- Note: 1:0..1 cardinality per collection_id is enforced by dbt generic tests
-- `source_unique_raw_revenue_recognitions_collection_id` (raw_sources.yml) and
-- `unique_stg_revenue_recognitions_collection_id` (_staging__models.yml), while
-- raw.revenue_recognitions DDL permits multi-row adjustments. Numeric aggregation
-- is kept strictly separate from deterministic latest-recognition selection below.
recognitions_agg_by_collection as (
    select
        collection_id,
        count(recognition_id) as recognition_count,
        sum(gross_collected_revenue) as gross_collected_revenue,
        sum(reversed_revenue_amount) as reversed_revenue_amount,
        sum(pass_through_cost) as pass_through_cost,
        sum(net_recognized_revenue) as net_recognized_revenue,
        max(recognized_at) as recognized_at
    from "analytics_platform"."analytics"."stg_revenue_recognitions"
    group by collection_id
),

ranked_recognitions_by_collection as (
    select

        row_number() over (
            partition by collection_id
            order by
                recognized_at desc,
                recognition_id desc
        ) as recognition_rank_desc
    from "analytics_platform"."analytics"."stg_revenue_recognitions"
),

latest_recognition_by_collection as (

        latest_recognition_id_for_collection
    from ranked_recognitions_by_collection
    where recognition_rank_desc = 1
),

        coalesce(rr.pass_through_cost, 0.0000) as pass_through_cost,
        coalesce(rr.net_recognized_revenue, 0.0000) as net_recognized_revenue,
        rr.recognized_at
    from "analytics_platform"."analytics"."stg_fee_collections" fc
    left join recognitions_agg_by_collection rr
        on fc.collection_id = rr.collection_id
    left join latest_recognition_by_collection lrc
        on fc.collection_id = lrc.collection_id

    select
        assessment_id,
        collection_id as latest_collection_id,
        recognition_id as latest_recognition_id,
        linked_ledger_entry_id,
        collection_status as latest_collection_status,
        failure_reason as latest_failure_reason,

-- =============================================================================
-- Model: int_customer_accounts
-- Grain: One row per customer bank account (account_id)
-- Purpose: Enrich customer accounts with customer profile, commercial segment,
--          and active overdraft facility terms without fan-out.
-- =============================================================================

with customers as (
    select
        customer_id,
        legal_entity_id,
        customer_name,
        customer_segment,
        customer_status,
        onboarding_date
    from {{ ref('stg_customers') }}
),

accounts as (
    select
        account_id,
        customer_id,
        account_number,
        account_type,
        account_currency,
        opening_balance,
        reserved_funds,
        initial_available_balance,
        account_status,
        opened_at,
        opened_date
    from {{ ref('stg_accounts') }}
),

overdraft_agg as (
    -- Pre-aggregate overdraft facilities per account_id to prevent fan-out
    select
        account_id,
        count(facility_id) as facility_count,
        max(facility_id) as primary_facility_id,
        sum(authorized_limit) as total_authorized_overdraft_limit,
        max(standard_interest_rate) as max_standard_interest_rate,
        max(unauthorized_penalty_rate) as max_unauthorized_penalty_rate,
        min(effective_start_date) as earliest_facility_start_date,
        max(effective_end_date) as latest_facility_end_date
    from {{ ref('stg_overdraft_facilities') }}
    group by account_id
)

select
    a.account_id,
    a.account_number,
    a.account_type,
    a.account_currency,
    a.opening_balance,
    a.reserved_funds,
    a.initial_available_balance,
    a.account_status,
    a.opened_at,
    a.opened_date,
    c.customer_id,
    c.legal_entity_id,
    c.customer_name,
    c.customer_segment,
    c.customer_status,
    c.onboarding_date,
    coalesce(od.facility_count, 0) > 0 as has_overdraft_facility,
    coalesce(od.facility_count, 0) as overdraft_facility_count,
    od.primary_facility_id,
    cast(coalesce(od.total_authorized_overdraft_limit, 0.0000) as numeric(18, 4)) as authorized_overdraft_limit,
    cast(
        a.initial_available_balance + coalesce(od.total_authorized_overdraft_limit, 0.0000)
        as numeric(18, 4)
    ) as initial_total_liquidity,
    od.max_standard_interest_rate as standard_interest_rate,
    od.max_unauthorized_penalty_rate as unauthorized_penalty_rate,
    od.earliest_facility_start_date,
    od.latest_facility_end_date
from accounts a
inner join customers c
    on a.customer_id = c.customer_id
left join overdraft_agg od
    on a.account_id = od.account_id

-- =============================================================================
-- Model: int_customer_revenue
-- Grain: One row per customer_id, reporting_month, currency, and revenue_category
-- Purpose: Aggregate customer fee assessments, waivers, collections, arrears,
--          reversals, pass-through costs, and net recognized revenue by native
--          currency and explicit EUR reporting value without cross-currency mixing.
-- =============================================================================

with fee_lifecycle as (
    select
        assessment_id,
        transaction_id,
        customer_id,
        customer_name,
        customer_segment,
        account_id,
        fee_type as revenue_category,
        currency,
        assessed_month as reporting_month,
        gross_assessed_amount,
        waived_amount,
        net_collectible_amount,
        collected_amount,
        outstanding_amount,
        gross_collected_revenue,
        reversed_amount,
        pass_through_cost,
        net_recognized_revenue,
        gross_assessed_amount_eur,
        waived_amount_eur,
        net_collectible_amount_eur,
        collected_amount_eur,
        outstanding_amount_eur,
        gross_collected_revenue_eur,
        reversed_amount_eur,
        pass_through_cost_eur,
        net_recognized_revenue_eur,
        total_collection_attempts,
        successful_collection_attempts,
        failed_collection_attempts
    from {{ ref('int_fee_lifecycle') }}
)

select
    customer_id,
    customer_name,
    customer_segment,
    reporting_month,
    currency,
    revenue_category,
    count(assessment_id) as assessment_count,
    count(distinct account_id) as active_fee_account_count,
    sum(total_collection_attempts) as collection_attempt_count,
    sum(successful_collection_attempts) as successful_collection_count,
    sum(failed_collection_attempts) as failed_collection_count,
    -- Native currency metrics (never mixed across currencies)
    cast(sum(gross_assessed_amount) as numeric(18, 4)) as gross_assessed_fee_amount,
    cast(sum(waived_amount) as numeric(18, 4)) as waived_fee_amount,
    cast(sum(net_collectible_amount) as numeric(18, 4)) as net_collectible_fee_amount,
    cast(sum(collected_amount) as numeric(18, 4)) as collected_fee_amount,
    cast(sum(outstanding_amount) as numeric(18, 4)) as outstanding_fee_amount,
    cast(sum(gross_collected_revenue) as numeric(18, 4)) as gross_collected_revenue,
    cast(sum(reversed_amount) as numeric(18, 4)) as reversed_revenue_amount,
    cast(sum(pass_through_cost) as numeric(18, 4)) as pass_through_cost_amount,
    cast(sum(net_recognized_revenue) as numeric(18, 4)) as net_recognized_revenue,
    -- Explicit EUR reporting equivalents (converted at daily ECB mid-rate per assessment)
    cast(sum(gross_assessed_amount_eur) as numeric(18, 4)) as gross_assessed_fee_amount_eur,
    cast(sum(waived_amount_eur) as numeric(18, 4)) as waived_fee_amount_eur,
    cast(sum(net_collectible_amount_eur) as numeric(18, 4)) as net_collectible_fee_amount_eur,
    cast(sum(collected_amount_eur) as numeric(18, 4)) as collected_fee_amount_eur,
    cast(sum(outstanding_amount_eur) as numeric(18, 4)) as outstanding_fee_amount_eur,
    cast(sum(gross_collected_revenue_eur) as numeric(18, 4)) as gross_collected_revenue_eur,
    cast(sum(reversed_amount_eur) as numeric(18, 4)) as reversed_revenue_amount_eur,
    cast(sum(pass_through_cost_eur) as numeric(18, 4)) as pass_through_cost_amount_eur,
    cast(sum(net_recognized_revenue_eur) as numeric(18, 4)) as net_recognized_revenue_eur
from fee_lifecycle
group by
    customer_id,
    customer_name,
    customer_segment,
    reporting_month,
    currency,
    revenue_category

test.enterprise_ai_analytics_platform.as.name: assert_no_assessment_overcollection
test.enterprise_ai_analytics_platform.as.raw_code:
-- =============================================================================
-- Singular Test: assert_no_assessment_overcollection
-- Invariant: Cumulative collected_amount for an assessment must never exceed
--            net_collectible_amount, and assessment-level reconciliation
--            net_collectible_amount = collected_amount + outstanding_amount
--            must hold exactly.
-- =============================================================================

select
    assessment_id,
    net_collectible_amount,
    collected_amount,
    outstanding_amount
from {{ ref('fct_fee_assessments') }}
where collected_amount > net_collectible_amount
   or outstanding_amount < 0.0000
   or abs(net_collectible_amount - (collected_amount + outstanding_amount)) > 0.0000

-- =============================================================================
-- Singular Test: assert_journal_balanced_per_currency
-- Invariant: Every accounting journal must balance independently per currency
--            leg: SUM(debit_amount) == SUM(credit_amount).
-- Returns failing (journal_id, currency) pairs where abs(diff) > 0.0000.
-- =============================================================================

select
    journal_id,
    currency,
    sum(debit_amount) as total_debits,
    sum(credit_amount) as total_credits,
    sum(debit_amount) - sum(credit_amount) as imbalance
from {{ ref('fct_ledger_entries') }}
group by
    journal_id,
    currency
having abs(sum(debit_amount) - sum(credit_amount)) > 0.0000

test.enterprise_ai_analytics_platform.as.name: assert_no_customer_revenue_fanout
test.enterprise_ai_analytics_platform.as.raw_code:
-- =============================================================================
-- Singular Test: assert_no_customer_revenue_fanout
-- Invariant: Aggregating fct_customer_revenue by currency must exactly equal
--            aggregating fct_fee_assessments by currency across all measures,
--            and total gross/net revenue across all currencies must match
--            stg_revenue_recognitions without any join fan-out.
-- =============================================================================

with assessment_totals as (
    select
        currency,
        count(assessment_id) as assessment_count,
        sum(gross_assessed_amount) as gross_assessed,
        sum(waived_amount) as waived,
        sum(net_collectible_amount) as net_collectible,
        sum(collected_amount) as collected,
        sum(outstanding_amount) as outstanding,
        sum(net_recognized_revenue) as net_revenue,
        sum(net_recognized_revenue_eur) as net_revenue_eur
    from {{ ref('fct_fee_assessments') }}
    group by currency
),

customer_rev_totals as (
    select
        currency,
        sum(assessment_count) as assessment_count,
        sum(gross_assessed_fee_amount) as gross_assessed,
        sum(waived_fee_amount) as waived,
        sum(net_collectible_fee_amount) as net_collectible,
        sum(collected_fee_amount) as collected,
        sum(outstanding_fee_amount) as outstanding,
        sum(net_recognized_revenue) as net_revenue,
        sum(net_recognized_revenue_eur) as net_revenue_eur
    from {{ ref('fct_customer_revenue') }}
    group by currency
)

select
    coalesce(a.currency, c.currency) as currency,
    a.assessment_count as assessment_cnt,
    c.assessment_count as customer_rev_cnt,
    a.gross_assessed as assessment_gross,
    c.gross_assessed as customer_rev_gross,
    a.net_revenue as assessment_net_rev,
    c.net_revenue as customer_rev_net_rev,
    a.net_revenue_eur as assessment_net_rev_eur,
    c.net_revenue_eur as customer_rev_net_rev_eur
from assessment_totals a
full outer join customer_rev_totals c
    on a.currency = c.currency
where a.currency is null
   or c.currency is null
   or a.assessment_count <> c.assessment_count
   or abs(a.gross_assessed - c.gross_assessed) > 0.0000
   or abs(a.waived - c.waived) > 0.0000
   or abs(a.net_collectible - c.net_collectible) > 0.0000
   or abs(a.collected - c.collected) > 0.0000
   or abs(a.outstanding - c.outstanding) > 0.0000
   or abs(a.net_revenue - c.net_revenue) > 0.0000
   or abs(a.net_revenue_eur - c.net_revenue_eur) > 0.0000

test.enterprise_ai_analytics_platform.as.name: assert_reversal_within_original_amount
test.enterprise_ai_analytics_platform.as.raw_code:
-- =============================================================================
-- Singular Test: assert_reversal_within_original_amount
-- Invariant:
--   1. Reversed fee revenue never exceeds gross collected revenue.
--   2. Reversal ledger postings (where original_entry_id is not null) never
--      exceed the amount of the original ledger posting they reverse.
-- =============================================================================

with invalid_revenue_reversals as (
    select
        recognition_id as record_id,
        'REVENUE_RECOGNITION' as violation_type,
        reversed_revenue_amount as reversal_amount,
        gross_collected_revenue as original_amount
    from {{ ref('stg_revenue_recognitions') }}
    where reversed_revenue_amount < 0.0000
       or reversed_revenue_amount > gross_collected_revenue
),

invalid_ledger_reversals as (
    select
        rev.entry_id as record_id,
        'LEDGER_REVERSAL' as violation_type,
        rev.amount as reversal_amount,
        coalesce(orig.amount, -1.0000) as original_amount
    from {{ ref('fct_ledger_entries') }} rev
    left join {{ ref('fct_ledger_entries') }} orig
        on rev.original_entry_id = orig.entry_id
    where rev.original_entry_id is not null
      and (
          orig.entry_id is null
          or rev.amount > orig.amount
          or rev.currency <> orig.currency
      )
)

select * from invalid_revenue_reversals
union all
select * from invalid_ledger_reversals

test.enterprise_ai_analytics_platform.as.raw_code:
-- =============================================================================
-- Singular Test: assert_revenue_recognition_equation
-- Invariant: Across all fee assessments, collections, and customer revenue marts:
--            net_recognized_revenue = gross_collected_revenue
--                                   - reversed_revenue_amount
--                                   - pass_through_cost
--            and gross_collected_revenue = collected_amount for settled collections.
-- =============================================================================

with invalid_assessments as (
    select
        'fct_fee_assessments' as model_name,
        assessment_id as record_id,
        gross_collected_revenue,
        reversed_amount as reversed_revenue_amount,
        pass_through_cost,
        net_recognized_revenue
    from {{ ref('fct_fee_assessments') }}
    where abs(
        net_recognized_revenue
        - (gross_collected_revenue - reversed_amount - pass_through_cost)
    ) > 0.0000
       or abs(gross_collected_revenue - collected_amount) > 0.0000
),

invalid_collections as (
    select
        'fct_fee_collections' as model_name,
        collection_id as record_id,
        gross_collected_revenue,
        reversed_revenue_amount,
        pass_through_cost,
        net_recognized_revenue
    from {{ ref('fct_fee_collections') }}
    where abs(
        net_recognized_revenue
        - (gross_collected_revenue - reversed_revenue_amount - pass_through_cost)
    ) > 0.0000
       or (collection_status in ('SETTLED', 'PARTIAL') and abs(gross_collected_revenue - collected_amount) > 0.0000)
),

invalid_customer_revenue as (
    select
        'fct_customer_revenue' as model_name,
        customer_revenue_id as record_id,
        gross_collected_revenue,
        reversed_revenue_amount,
        pass_through_cost_amount as pass_through_cost,
        net_recognized_revenue
    from {{ ref('fct_customer_revenue') }}
    where abs(
        net_recognized_revenue
        - (gross_collected_revenue - reversed_revenue_amount - pass_through_cost_amount)
    ) > 0.0000
)

select * from invalid_assessments
union all
select * from invalid_collections
union all
select * from invalid_customer_revenue

test.enterprise_ai_analytics_platform.as.name: assert_latest_collection_attributes_consistency
test.enterprise_ai_analytics_platform.as.raw_code:
-- =============================================================================
-- Singular Test: assert_latest_collection_attributes_consistency
-- Invariant: On fct_fee_assessments, latest_collection_id, latest_recognition_id,
--            collection_status, and failure_reason must exactly match the
--            chronologically latest attempt in fct_fee_collections (ordered by
--            attempted_at DESC, collection_attempt_number DESC, collection_id DESC)
--            and latest recognition in stg_revenue_recognitions (ordered by
--            recognized_at DESC, recognition_id DESC), and settled collections
--            must never carry a non-null failure_reason.
-- =============================================================================

with ranked_recognitions as (
    select
        collection_id,
        recognition_id,
        row_number() over (
            partition by collection_id
            order by
                recognized_at desc,
                recognition_id desc
        ) as rn
    from {{ ref('stg_revenue_recognitions') }}
),

ranked_attempts as (
    select
        fc.assessment_id,
        fc.collection_id,
        rr.recognition_id,
        fc.collection_status,
        fc.failure_reason,
        row_number() over (
            partition by fc.assessment_id
            order by
                fc.attempted_at desc,
                fc.collection_attempt_number desc,
                fc.collection_id desc
        ) as rn
    from {{ ref('fct_fee_collections') }} fc
    left join ranked_recognitions rr
        on fc.collection_id = rr.collection_id
        and rr.rn = 1
),

latest_attempt as (
    select
        assessment_id,
        collection_id as expected_collection_id,
        recognition_id as expected_recognition_id,
        collection_status as expected_status,
        failure_reason as expected_failure_reason
    from ranked_attempts
    where rn = 1
)

select
    fa.assessment_id,
    fa.latest_collection_id,
    la.expected_collection_id,
    fa.latest_recognition_id,
    la.expected_recognition_id,
    fa.collection_status,
    la.expected_status,
    fa.failure_reason,
    la.expected_failure_reason
from {{ ref('fct_fee_assessments') }} fa
inner join latest_attempt la
    on fa.assessment_id = la.assessment_id
where fa.latest_collection_id is distinct from la.expected_collection_id
   or fa.latest_recognition_id is distinct from la.expected_recognition_id
   or fa.collection_status is distinct from la.expected_status
   or fa.failure_reason is distinct from la.expected_failure_reason
   or (fa.collection_status = 'SETTLED' and fa.failure_reason is not null)

macro.dbt_postgres.postgres__list_relati.macro_sql:
{% macro postgres__list_relations_without_caching(schema_relation) %}
  {% call statement('list_relations_without_caching', fetch_result=True) -%}
    select
      '{{ schema_relation.database }}' as database,
      tablename as name,
      schemaname as schema,
      'table' as type
    from pg_tables
    where schemaname ilike '{{ schema_relation.schema }}'
    union all
    select
      '{{ schema_relation.database }}' as database,
      viewname as name,
      schemaname as schema,
      'view' as type
    from pg_views
    where schemaname ilike '{{ schema_relation.schema }}'
    union all
    select
      '{{ schema_relation.database }}' as database,
      matviewname as name,
      schemaname as schema,
      'materialized_view' as type
    from pg_matviews
    where schemaname ilike '{{ schema_relation.schema }}'
    union all
    select distinct
     '{{ schema_relation.database }}' as database,
     proname as name,
     ns.nspname as schema,
     'function' as type
    from pg_proc
     join pg_namespace as ns on pronamespace = ns.oid
    where ns.nspname ilike '{{ schema_relation.schema }}'
  {% endcall %}
  {{ return(load_result('list_relations_without_caching').table) }}
{% endmacro %}

macro.dbt_postgres.postgres__get_show_in.macro_sql:
{% macro postgres__get_show_indexes_sql(relation) %}
    select
        i.relname                                   as name,
        m.amname                                    as method,
        ix.indisunique                              as "unique",
        array_to_string(array_agg(a.attname), ',')  as column_names
    from pg_index ix
    join pg_class i
        on i.oid = ix.indexrelid
    join pg_am m
        on m.oid=i.relam
    join pg_class t
        on t.oid = ix.indrelid
    join pg_namespace n
        on n.oid = t.relnamespace
    join pg_attribute a
        on a.attrelid = t.oid
        and a.attnum = ANY(ix.indkey)
    where t.relname = '{{ relation.identifier }}'
      and n.nspname = '{{ relation.schema }}'
      and t.relkind in ('r', 'm')
    group by 1, 2, 3
    order by 1, 2, 3
{% endmacro %}

macro.dbt_postgres.postgres__get_relatio.name: postgres__get_relations
macro.dbt_postgres.postgres__get_relatio.macro_sql:
{% macro postgres__get_relations() -%}

  {#
      -- in pg_depend, objid is the dependent, refobjid is the referenced object
      --  > a pg_depend entry indicates that the referenced object cannot be
      --  > dropped without also dropping the dependent object.
  #}

  {%- call statement('relations', fetch_result=True) -%}
    select distinct
        dependent_namespace.nspname as dependent_schema,
        dependent_class.relname as dependent_name,
        referenced_namespace.nspname as referenced_schema,
        referenced_class.relname as referenced_name

    -- Query for views: views are entries in pg_class with an entry in pg_rewrite, but we avoid
    -- a seq scan on pg_rewrite by leveraging the fact there is an "internal" row in pg_depend for
    -- the view...
    from pg_class as dependent_class
    join pg_namespace as dependent_namespace on dependent_namespace.oid = dependent_class.relnamespace
    join pg_depend as dependent_depend on dependent_depend.refobjid = dependent_class.oid
        and dependent_depend.classid = 'pg_rewrite'::regclass
        and dependent_depend.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass
        and dependent_depend.deptype = 'i'

    -- ... and via pg_depend (that has a row per column, hence the need for "distinct" above, and
    -- making sure to exclude the internal row to avoid a view appearing to depend on itself)...
    join pg_depend as joining_depend on joining_depend.objid = dependent_depend.objid
        and joining_depend.classid = 'pg_rewrite'::regclass
        and joining_depend.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass
        and joining_depend.refobjid != dependent_depend.refobjid

    -- ... we can find the tables they query from in pg_class, but excluding system tables. Note we
    -- don't need need to exclude _dependent_ system tables, because they only query from other
    -- system tables, and so are automatically excluded by excluding _referenced_ system tables
    join pg_class as referenced_class on referenced_class.oid = joining_depend.refobjid
    join pg_namespace as referenced_namespace on referenced_namespace.oid = referenced_class.relnamespace
        and referenced_namespace.nspname != 'information_schema'
        and referenced_namespace.nspname not like 'pg\_%'

    order by
        dependent_schema, dependent_name, referenced_schema, referenced_name;

  {%- endcall -%}

  {{ return(load_result('relations').table) }}
{% endmacro %}

doc.dbt.__overview__.block_contents:
### Welcome!

Welcome to the auto-generated documentation for your dbt project!

### Navigation

You can use the `Project` and `Database` navigation tabs on the left side of the window to explore the models
in your project.

#### Project Tab
The `Project` tab mirrors the directory structure of your dbt project. In this tab, you can see all of the
models defined in your dbt project, as well as models imported from dbt packages.

#### Database Tab
The `Database` tab also exposes your models, but in a format that looks more like a database explorer. This view
shows relations (tables and views) grouped into database schemas. Note that ephemeral models are _not_ shown
in this interface, as they do not exist in the database.

### Graph Exploration
You can click the blue icon on the bottom-right corner of the page to view the lineage graph of your models.

On model pages, you'll see the immediate parents and children of the model you're exploring. By clicking the `Expand`
button at the top-right of this lineage pane, you'll be able to see all of the models that are used to build,
or are built from, the model you're exploring.

Once expanded, you'll be able to use the `--select` and `--exclude` model selection syntax to filter the
models in the graph. For more information on model selection, check out the [dbt docs](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/model-selection-syntax).

Note that you can also right-click on models to interactively filter and explore the graph.

---

- Read the [dbt viewpoint](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/viewpoint)

- Join the [dbt Community](https://www.getdbt.com/community/) for questions and discussion
